name: Bramble barrier (grey-box prefab)
notes: A 4 m leaf of thorny briar that closes a gap in a Briarwood hedge (mw-e25.1). Ivy material (the briars of the material notes): flammable, cuttable and soft, so fire or a blade breaks it and the way behind it opens, for walkers and for the navmesh. Never opened by hand: nobody pushes through thorns. It shuts out nothing but the way.
